
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19762829" title="发布于 2026-03-24 11:38">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET对象转JSON，到底有几种方式？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        对象转JSON这事儿，说大不大，说小不小。选对了库，代码跑得溜；选错了，要么功能不够用，要么性能拉胯。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>问题：对象转JSON，到底该用哪个库？</span></span></h2>
<p><span>前几天在其中一个群里看到个挺有意思的对话：</span></p>
<blockquote>
<p><span>“兄弟，你那个接口返回的JSON咋弄的？”</span></p>
<p><span>“就JsonConvert.SerializeObject啊，还能咋弄。”</span></p>
<p><span>“这不是Newtonsoft.Json吗？现在新项目不是推荐用System.Text.Json？”</span></p>
<p><span>“啊？这俩啥区别？我用了好几年Newtonsoft了，没出过问题啊。”</span></p>
</blockquote>
<p><span>说实话，这种困惑太常见了。.NET里对象转JSON的方式确实不少，而且各有各的脾气。今天咱们就把这事捋清楚，以后别再纠结了。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>结论：三种主流方式，各有各的用武之地</span></span></h2>
<p><span>一句话总结：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>System.Text.Json<span>：.NET亲儿子，性能好，新项目首选</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Newtonsoft.Json<span>：老牌王者，功能全，旧项目维护离不开</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Utf8Json<span>：性能狂魔，追求极致速度的备选方案</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span>下面一个一个聊，看看它们到底有啥不一样。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>展开：三种方式深度对比</span></span></h2>
<h3><span>1. System.Text.Json：官方出品，性能担当</span></h3>
<p><span>从.NET Core 3.0开始，微软自己搞了个JSON处理库，就是<code><span>System.Text.Json</span></code><span>。为啥要自己造轮子？因为要追求高性能、低内存占用<span>，充分利用了<code><span>Span&lt;T&gt;</span></code><span>这些现代.NET特性。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p>基本用法：</p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">using&nbsp;System.Text.Json;</span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">var&nbsp;user =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;{ Name =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">"码农刚子", Age =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">30, City =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">"北京"&nbsp;};</span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 基础序列化</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;jsonString = JsonSerializer.Serialize(user);</span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 带配置的序列化（格式化输出）</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">var&nbsp;options =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;JsonSerializerOptions&nbsp;</span></span></span></code><code><span>{&nbsp;</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; WriteIndented =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__literal">true, &nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 格式化，更易读</span></span></span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase &nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 驼峰命名</span></span></code><code><span>};</span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;prettyJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(user, options);</span></span></code></pre>
<p>它强在哪？</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>性能好<span>：比Newtonsoft.Json快，内存分配少</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>零依赖<span>：.NET Core/5+自带，不用装NuGet包</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>默认严格<span>：属性名必须匹配，提前发现问题</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>它坑在哪？</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>功能相对少<span>：有些Newtonsoft花哨的功能它没有</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>日期格式支持有限<span>：不如Newtonsoft灵活</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>属性名默认转驼峰<span>：以前用PascalCase的老代码要改</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>适用场景：</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>新项目，尤其是.NET Core 3.0+</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>追求性能的Web API</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>云原生应用，需要控制内存</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>2. Newtonsoft.Json（Json.NET）：老牌王者，功能最全</span></h3>
<p><span>在<code><span>System.Text.Json</span></code><span>出生之前，Newtonsoft.Json就是.NET社区的事实标准。几乎所有.NET项目都在用它，至今仍有大量项目依赖。</span></span></p>
<p>基本用法：</p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">using&nbsp;Newtonsoft.Json;</span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">var&nbsp;user =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;{ Name =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">"码农刚子", Age =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">30, City =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">"北京"&nbsp;};</span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 基础序列化</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;jsonString = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(user);</span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 带配置的序列化</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">var&nbsp;settings =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;JsonSerializerSettings&nbsp;</span></span></span></code><code><span>{&nbsp;</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; Formatting = Formatting.Indented, &nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 格式化</span></span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; ReferenceLoopHandling = ReferenceLoopHandling.Ignore &nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 忽略循环引用</span></span></code><code><span>};</span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;complexJson = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(user, settings);</span></span></code></pre>
<p>它强在哪？</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>功能极其丰富<span>：循环引用处理、自定义转换器、条件序列化...</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>容错性强<span>：JSON格式不太规范也能处理</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>文档全、社区大<span>：遇到问题一搜一大把</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>它坑在哪？</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>性能稍逊<span>：比System.Text.Json慢一点</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>额外依赖<span>：需要装NuGet包</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>体积较大<span>：功能多，体积自然大</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>适用场景：</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>维护老项目，尤其是.NET Framework项目</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>需要复杂JSON处理的场景（循环引用、动态对象等）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>对接的第三方接口JSON格式乱七八糟</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>3. Utf8Json：性能狂魔，极致追求</span></h3>
<p><span>如果你对性能有近乎苛刻的要求，比如高频交易、游戏服务器这类场景，可以看看<code><span>Utf8Json</span></code><span>。</span></span></p>
<p>基本用法：</p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">using&nbsp;Utf8Json;</span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">var&nbsp;product =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;{ ID =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">101, Name =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">"鼠标", Price =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">99.9&nbsp;};</span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 直接序列化为二进制字节数组（最快）</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">byte[] jsonBytes = JsonSerializer.Serialize(product);</span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 转成字符串</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;jsonString = JsonSerializer.ToJsonString(product);</span></span></code></pre>
<p>它强在哪？</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>速度极快<span>：直接操作UTF-8字节流，跳过中间步骤</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>内存分配少<span>：不使用反射，通过IL生成代码</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>零分配<span>：在某些场景下能做到</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>它坑在哪？</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>功能有限<span>：就是个序列化工具，别指望花哨功能</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>社区小<span>：遇到问题不好查</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>学习成本<span>：用法和前面两个不太一样</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>适用场景：</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>性能瓶颈处，局部优化</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>高频调用的小对象序列化</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>内存受限的环境</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span><span>怎么选？给个实在的建议</span></span></h2>
<p><span>看完了上面三种，估计有人要问：那我到底该用哪个？</span></p>
<p><span>我一般这么建议：</span></p>
<p>1. 如果你是全新项目，用.NET Core 3.0以上：<span><br><span>优先用<code><span>System.Text.Json</span></code><span>。官方出品，性能好，少装一个包是一个，以后升级也省心。</span></span></span></p>
<p>2. 如果你在维护老项目：<span><br><span>继续用<code><span>Newtonsoft.Json</span></code><span>，别折腾。老代码跑得好好的，换库容易出幺蛾子。</span></span></span></p>
<p>3. 如果你的项目已经用了Newtonsoft，但想换：<span><br><span>建议谨慎。两个库有不少差异：</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>默认属性命名策略不同（camelCase vs 原样）</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span>日期格式处理不同</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span>某些高级特性不兼容</span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<p><span>真想换，做好充分测试。</span></p>
<p>4. 如果你在写性能敏感的核心代码：<span><br><span>可以考虑局部用<code><span>Utf8Json</span></code><span>做优化，但别整个项目都用，毕竟功能有限。</span></span></span></p>
<h2><span>实用小技巧</span></h2>
<p>给System.Text.Json配置全局选项：</p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="javascript"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// Program.cs 或 Startup.cs</span></span></code><code><span>builder.<span class="code-snippet__property">Services.<span class="code-snippet__property">Configure&lt;<span class="code-snippet__title">JsonOptions&gt;(<span class="code-snippet__function">options<span class="code-snippet__function">&nbsp;=&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>{</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; options.<span class="code-snippet__property">SerializerOptions.<span class="code-snippet__property">WriteIndented&nbsp;=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__literal">true;</span></span></span></span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; options.<span class="code-snippet__property">SerializerOptions.<span class="code-snippet__property">PropertyNamingPolicy&nbsp;=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">JsonNamingPolicy.<span class="code-snippet__property">CamelCase;</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; options.<span class="code-snippet__property">SerializerOptions.<span class="code-snippet__property">DefaultIgnoreCondition&nbsp;=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">JsonIgnoreCondition.<span class="code-snippet__property">WhenWritingNull;</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>});</span></code></pre>
<p>Newtonsoft.Json处理循环引用：</p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="javascript"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">var&nbsp;settings =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">JsonSerializerSettings</span></span></span></span></code><code><span>{</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">ReferenceLoopHandling&nbsp;=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">ReferenceLoopHandling.<span class="code-snippet__property">Ignore, &nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 忽略循环引用</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">PreserveReferencesHandling&nbsp;=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">PreserveReferencesHandling.<span class="code-snippet__property">Objects&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 或保留引用</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>};</span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">var&nbsp;json =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">JsonConvert.<span class="code-snippet__title">SerializeObject(objWithCycle, settings);</span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>性能优化小贴士：</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>重复序列化相同对象，考虑缓存结果</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>大JSON用流式处理，别一次全加载</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>自定义转换器处理特殊类型</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>总结</span></h2>
<p><span>对象转JSON这事儿，说大不大，说小不小。选对了库，代码跑得溜；选错了，要么功能不够用，要么性能拉胯。</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>新项目<span>：System.Text.Json</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>老项目<span>：Newtonsoft.Json</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>极致性能<span>：Utf8Json</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span>记住这个原则，以后别再凭感觉选了。</span></p>
<hr>
